message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/elfutils && cat libdwfl/relocate.c | head -200

message.content: This is about unaligned access, not uninitialized values. Let me look at the actual OSS-Fuzz issue. The issue 42521280 is from around 2022. Let me check the git log for the specific fix. Let me look at the `__libdwfl_relocate` function since the fuzz target uses `dwfl_module_getdwarf` which for ET_REL files calls `__libdwfl_relocate`.
